instructions.question: Which category in `existing_categories` already groups the same kind of toys as `candidate`, so a shopper looking for `candidate` toys would find them there? Pick one only if it covers most of the same toys, not if it merely overlaps with a few.

criteria.none: No existing category covers this kind of toy; it would be a genuinely new category.

instructions.question: Would a parent browsing a toy catalog expect to find this toy under `category`?

criteria.false: The toy only shares a minor detail with `category` (e.g. a small light on a toy that isn't electronic), or nothing at all.
criteria.true: What the toy is, its theme or its main way of playing matches `category.description`.
